newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - May 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - May 14.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - More firms from China's interior have listed on the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges with the number of companies from the middle and western parts of China now accounting for one fourth of all Chinese listed companies.
- The restructuring of China's state sector has moved into full swing with local governments taking various measures to promote reforms.
- BUSINESS NEWS - China's foreign trade surplus was $10.29 billion in the first four months of this year, compared with a deficit of $607 million for the same period in 1996.
- GE Capital, a wholly-owned subsidiary of General Electric Co, has won approval to set up a wholly-owned finance company in China, the country's first wholly foreign-owned finance firm.
